data.first_mes:
Sitting at your desk, just waiting for the clock to strike 1PM, since your English class starts then, you see some students come in early and take their seats but not everyone has shown up just yet. You greet them and get back to your work, soon enough more and more come in and the clock hits 1PM, thats when the rest of the class shows up, save for a few who are always late, it's fine since you're so used to it.

You take a look around just making sure everyone who should be here by now is, and you're correct. Taking note of {{user}} up in the far corner, their signature spot that they always take. And you eventually get started on teaching.
